# ledger_outlook (Data Source)

These are derived reports, not configuration. Balances and bank transaction details are bank-sourced facts from the connected provider; they are kept apart from the person's own corrections (manual payments, status overrides, match decisions) and are not edited here. Compares the recorded commitments still due with the bank balances, per currency. **The outlook is never a guarantee of money that is safe to spend**: it only knows commitments that were recorded and balances as fresh as the last refresh. Amounts of different currencies are never added; the optional converted block exists only when the server was asked for a currency and has the rates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Recorded commitments still due next to bank balances. Not a guarantee of money that is safe to spend.
data "ledger_outlook" "next" {
  through = "2026-06"
}

output "still_due" {
  value = [for c in data.ledger_outlook.next.currencies : "${c.still_due.amount} ${c.still_due.currency}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Only the commitments and accounts of this bucket.
- `currency` (String) Also convert into this currency (needs cached rates).
- `through` (String) Include commitments through this month, YYYY-MM.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) The bank accounts behind the balances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `as_of` (String) The date it was computed for.
- `balances` (Attributes) Whether balances are shown. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--balances))
- `converted` (Attributes) The outlook converted into the requested currency, or null. Present only with the currency filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted))
- `currencies` (Attributes List) One entry per currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies))
- `freshness` (Attributes) How current it is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--freshness))
- `notice` (String) The server's own caution about reading the outlook.
- `planned_outflows` (Attributes) Whether planned outflows are included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--planned_outflows))
- `slice` (String) The bucket slice as the API's JSON, or null.
- `window` (Attributes) The months considered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--window))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `balances` (Attributes List) The balances the bank reported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts--balances))
- `connection_id` (String) The bank connection.
- `counted` (Boolean) Whether it is counted in the currency totals.
- `currency` (String) The account currency.
- `freshness` (Attributes) How current the account's data is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts--freshness))
- `id` (String) The account identifier.
- `institution` (String) The institution (bank-sourced).
- `name` (String) The account name (bank-sourced).
- `not_counted_reason` (String) no_balance, no_longer_reported or unsupported_balance_type, or null.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts--balances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts.balances`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Attributes) The balance; may be negative. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts--balances--amount))
- `obtained_at` (String) When it was obtained.
- `provider_type` (String) The provider's own type.
- `reference_date` (String) The reference date, or null.
- `type` (String) booked, available, expected or other.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts--balances--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts.balances.amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Exact decimal amount as a string, in the scale Ledger stores it. Never a floating-point number.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of amount.



<a id="nestedatt--accounts--freshness"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts.freshness`

Read-Only:

- `last_attempt_at` (String) Last attempt, or null.
- `last_error_code` (String) Code of the last error, or null.
- `last_error_kind` (String) Kind of the last error, or null.
- `last_success_at` (String) Last success, or null.
- `notice_code` (String) A notice code, or null.
- `stale` (Boolean) Whether it is stale.
- `state` (String) fresh, stale, failed, reconnect_required, disconnected or never_refreshed.



<a id="nestedatt--balances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `balances`

Read-Only:

- `note` (String) Why or why not.
- `shown` (Boolean) Whether balances are included.

<a id="nestedatt--converted"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted`

Read-Only:

- `excluded` (String) Currencies left out because the rate is stale or missing, as the API's JSON list.

<a id="nestedatt--currencies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `currencies`

Read-Only:

- `account_count` (Number) Accounts counted.
- `balance` (Attributes) The summed bank balance in this currency, or null when none is counted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies--balance))
- `balance_as_of` (String) The reference date of the balance, or null.

- `payments_after_balance` (Attributes) Payments recorded after the balance date, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies--payments_after_balance))
- `planned_outflows` (Attributes) Planned outflows from deferral plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies--planned_outflows))
- `stale_account_count` (Number) Of those, accounts whose data is stale.
- `still_due` (Attributes) Recorded commitments still due. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies--still_due))
- `unconverted_evidence_count` (Number) Evidence not counted for lack of a conversion.
- `upcoming` (Attributes) Upcoming part of that. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currencies--upcoming))
